title: Chunk
description: The retrieval grain of the ingestion pipeline: a span of one IngestedDocument's text, with an optional embedding. Generalizes Noetica doc-store chunkTextWithSpans + hgPutChunk (text + vector + provenance DocumentChunk atoms). The span is not decorative: the validator recomputes text[start:end] == this chunk's text, so a chunk can never silently misquote the document it cites. When present, `embedding` MUST name the one sovereign embedding model and dimension (see EmbeddingRequest) — this is what stops two producers from writing into two different, silently-incomparable vector spaces.

id.description: Stable URN identifier. Pattern: urn:srcos:chunk:<local-id>. Identity is stable and never reused.

specVersion.description: Contract version, pinned per the tranche-0001 discipline. Changing this const is a contract change.

documentRef.description: URN of the IngestedDocument this chunk is a span of. Must resolve within the corpus.

idx.description: 0-based ordinal of the chunk within the document.

text.description: The chunk text. Invariant (validator): equals documentText[span.start:span.end].

start.description: 0-based inclusive character offset into the document's hashed text.

end.description: Exclusive character offset. Invariant (validator): 0 <= start < end <= len(text).

contentHash.description: sha256 of `text`. Recomputed by the validator.

embedding.description: Optional. The chunk's vector in the SHARED embedding space. A chunk may exist before it is embedded; once embedded it must use the pinned model/dimension.

model.description: The embedding model id. Invariant (validator): equals the pinned EmbeddingRequest.model.

dimension.description: Vector dimension. Invariant: equals the pinned dimension AND len(vector).
